rows.en:
(It's great that a new planet's been found,
but I'm a little uneasy about what kind
of planet it'll turn out to be...)

Yo, Fresh Boy.
A new planet's just been found,
so what's with the long face?

Oh, Luis-san.
It's just, I'm a little worried about what
might happen on the new planet...

Gaah! Don't go worryin' over piddly stuff like that!
Jeez, you still ain't got enough passion.

Can't be helped...
I'm gonna retrain your passion from scratch!!
Now let's go! Follow me!

(But training my passion...
What are you planning to do, Luis-san?)
rows.notes: Inner monologue addressed to Luis, as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
(Still, even with a new planet found,
Luis-san's the same as ever.)
(Maybe that means I should just act like usual, too?)

(It's great that a new planet's been found,
but I'm a little uneasy about what kind
of planet it'll turn out to be...)

Yo, Fresh Girl.
A new planet's just been found,
so what's with the long face?

(Still, even with a new planet found,
Luis-san's the same as ever...)
(Maybe that means I should just act like usual, too?)

(I came to school to do maintenance on my EX-Gear,
but maybe I came way too early...)

Yo, Fresh Boy.
Good mornin' to ya.
rows.notes: English 'good morning' in katakana in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Oh, good morning, Luis-san.
What are you doing here so early?

Woke up a little early, y'see.
So I figured, why not be
the first one at school?

So, Fresh Boy or not,
I ain't givin' up first place to you!
Ah, wait for me, Luis-san!
rows.notes: Also used in nml_lis_021 (Luis runs off ahead there too).

rows.en:
(...What does Luis-san even want
with being first at school?)
(He really is a man of mystery...)

(I came to school to do maintenance on my EX-Gear,
but maybe I came way too early...)

Yo, Fresh Girl.
Good mornin' to ya.

So, Fresh Girl or not,
I ain't givin' up first place to you!

(...What does Luis-san even want
with being first at school?)
(He really is a man of mystery...)
(No way... It's this bad......)
This is awful...
Why... Why did this have to happen...!

It's my fault...
It's 'cause my passion wasn't strong enough......!

But I ain't lettin' them do as they please any longer!
I... I'm gonna protect Frontier!
rows.notes: 'Frontier' without article, as c02442. 'them' = the attackers (yatsura).

rows.en: (Yeah! If there's something I can do too...!)
(Yeah! If there's something I can do too...!)

(The tests are finally over,
so maybe just for today I'll go somewhere
and have a blast.)
What's with the happy face, Fresh Boy?

Oh, Luis-san.
The tests finally ended a little while ago,
so I was just feeling relieved.
Tests, huh... Now that takes me back...

Come to think of it, Luis-san,
did you get good grades back when
you were a student?

Heh, naturally.
I flunked, of course. What'd you expect, Fresh Boy?
(He doesn't have to look so proud about it...)

Can't be helped.
To celebrate your tests bein' over,
I'll let you hear my soul!

All riiight, here we go!
Listen to my sooooong!!

(I appreciate him celebrating for me, but
singing for hours straight is a bit much...)
What's with the happy face, Fresh Girl?

Heh, naturally.
I flunked, of course. What'd you expect, Fresh Girl?
(He doesn't have to look so proud about it...)
(Hmm, what should I have for dinner tonight?)

A lad in the bloom of youth, lost in thought
at school in the evening...
Now that's a picture, ain't it......

What kinda worries are you carryin' around,
young man?

Oh, Luis-san.
No, I was just trying to decide
what to have for dinner...

That's youth too, Fresh Boy.
As thanks for the fine sight,
dinner's on me.
Huh? Are you sure?
rows.notes: Also used in scd_com_104 (Claire offers to take the player to the library).

rows.en:
Don't worry about it.
Anything you can't eat?
No, nothing in particular.

I see......
Then maybe you can handle THAT...
That?

All right, we're heading to Nyan-Nyan!
Their bizarre-food full course...
I bet you'll love it.
Let's go! Fresh Boy!

(A bizarre-food full course...
I bet there's no food in the world
Luis-san can't stomach...)

A lass in the bloom of youth, lost in thought
at school in the evening...
Now that's a picture, ain't it......
What kinda worries are you carryin' around?

That's youth too, Fresh Girl.
As thanks for the fine sight,
dinner's on me.
Let's go! Fresh Girl!
